extraction.name: XTREME-S
extraction.description: A benchmark to evaluate universal cross-lingual speech representations in many languages.
extraction.creator: Alexis Conneau, Ankur Bapna, Yu Zhang, Min Ma, Patrick von Platen, Anton Lozhkov, Colin Cherry, Ye Jia, Clara Rivera, Mihir Kale, Daan Van Esch, Vera Axelrod, Simran Khanuja, Jonathan H. Clark, Orhan Firat, Michael Auli, Sebastian Ruder, Jason Riesa, Melvin Johnson
extraction.publisher: Google Research, Hugging Face, Meta AI
extraction.citeAs: Conneau et al., XTREME-S: Evaluating Cross-lingual Speech Representations
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset is collected from various sources including read speech, parliamentary speech, and speech transcriptions and translations.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Physical data collection, Software Collection, Web Scraping, Web API
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Some languages have limited or no data available.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The raw data collection includes speech and text data from various sources such as VoxPopuli, MLS, Common Voice, and mC4.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: The timeframe for data collection is not explicitly stated.
extraction.rai:dataImputationProtocol: No data imputation protocol is mentioned.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Data manipulation protocol is not mentioned.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Data preprocessing steps include fine-tuning and multilingual fine-tuning.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotations were created by human annotators for tasks such as speech recognition, speech translation, and speech classification.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: The platform used for data annotation is not explicitly stated.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Considerations related to the process of converting raw annotations into final labels are not discussed.
extraction.rai:annotationsPerItem: The number of human labels per dataset item varies across tasks.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: Demographics specifications about the annotators are not provided.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Machine annotation tools used include wav2vec 2.0 and mSLAM.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset is made easily accessible through the HuggingFace platform, with versioning information and updating timeframe not explicitly stated.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Personal sensitive information collected includes language, geographical location, and number of speakers.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset aims to promote multilingual speech understanding and provide equal voice to speakers of under-represented languages.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Biases in the dataset include discrepancy between European and African languages in terms of data availability and quality.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Limitations include data generalization limits, quality issues, and non-recommended uses.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Use cases include training, testing, validation, and fine-tuning of multilingual speech models.
